sets.title: LDLR missense variant effects on LDLR cell-surface abundance.
sets.experiment_title: The functional landscape of coding variation in the familial hypercholesterolemia gene LDLR.
sets.experiment_method: We applied a multiplexed in vitro assay measuring LDLR cell-surface abundance via immunofluorescence. Barcoded cDNA libraries collectively containing nearly all possible single amino acid substitutions in LDLR were introduced at a genomically integrated Bxb1 “landing pad” in HeLa cells lacking endogenous LDLR. Cells were selected for LDL uptake via fluorescence-activated cell sorting. Functional scores were calculated by comparing barcode abundance in selected and unselected populations and scaled such that scores of 0 and 1 correspond to the median behaviour of nonsense and synonymous variants. Variants in the familial hypercholesterolemia gene LDLR can raise circulating low-density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol concentrations and increase the risk of premature atherosclerosis. Definitive classifications are lacking for nearly half of clinically encountered LDLR missense variants.
